candidate.title: 4sUDRB-Seq
candidate.scope: The single 4sUDRB-Seq workflow in the assigned Illumina schematic, from reversible DRB inhibition of initiated RNAPII in cells through 4sU labeling, biotin/streptavidin enrichment, elution, and the broad reverse-transcription/amplification block ending in cDNA. The matching RNA collection page is headed 4sUDRB-Seq and captions this as a schematic overview of 4sUDRB-seq. These capitalizations name the same target. The far-left transcription picture supplies biological context; no alternative target workflows or experimental branches are named. TruSeq RNA preparation is a downstream component. The 2014 full text resolves the intact-cell labeling and library interface; the 2015 protocol is checked at abstract level only. A single representative material route is drawn; the paper explains the timed-sample readout without adding a sequencing or analysis operation to the figure.
